# Skills reference

Skills are **doctrine**, not commands: install them and Claude writes different code.

All 7 ship in the `rails-stack` plugin, and each is also downloadable as a
standalone `.skill` for claude.ai.


## `rails-8`

Playbook for building full-stack Ruby on Rails 8.1 applications "the Rails way" — vanilla Rails, Hotwire (Turbo + Stimulus), the Solid stack, Propshaft + importmap, RSpec testing, ecosystem gems, OpenAPI docs, AI features, observability, and Kamal 2 deployment.

24 reference file(s): `advanced-active-record`, `ai-llm`, `api-documentation`, `auth-security`, `controllers-routing`, `deployment-kamal`, `directory-structure`, `ecosystem-gems`, `extending-rails`, `i18n`, `jobs-and-realtime`, `mail-storage-richtext`, `mcp-server`, `models`, `multi-tenancy`, `observability`, `performance-caching`, `project-setup`, `pwa`, `rails-8-2-readiness`, `sso`, `style`, `testing`, `views-hotwire`


## `hotwire`

Hotwire reference: Turbo (Drive, Frames, Streams, morphing page refreshes, broadcasts), Stimulus (controllers, actions, targets, values, outlets) and Hotwire Native (iOS/Android shells, bridge components, path configuration).

4 reference file(s): `native`, `production`, `stimulus`, `turbo`


## `design-system`

The design system — how to architect and build consistent, modern, responsive interfaces, brand-parameterised via brand packs.
